topic: An analysis of whether a low-IQ basketball play by Pascal Siakam in the final seconds of a Pacers-Hawks game is the dumbest NBA play ever.

script: Is this the dumbest NBA play ever? You see, the Pacers are down 3 points with little time left and no time outs. And you probably think they should shoot a 3, but instead Siakam decides to drive into an open lane. But the reason it's wide open is because the Hawks know the Pacers need to shoot a 3. Siakam takes the free 2 points, but then his whole team realizes there's only 1.3 seconds left in the game. The Pacers now have to foul and the Hawks get free throws with 0.5 seconds left, which leads to the Pacers losing the game as Trae intentionally misses his free throw to waste the last second.
